component.name: Matras
component.summary: Chat, threads and calls on a Mattermost server

description.p: A native Mattermost client for GNOME. Channels, threads, reactions and the inbox in an adaptive libadwaita window, with Mattermost Calls handled by a built-in WebRTC peer.
Sign in with a password, MFA or single sign-on; the session token is kept in the Secret Service rather than on disk.

screenshot.caption: A channel, its thread panel and the call dock

description.p: A pass over the GNOME Human Interface Guidelines:

ul.li: Dialogs are adaptive: confirmations ask a question with Cancel and a verb, forms have their action in the header, and on a phone they open as bottom sheets
One Preferences dialog for notifications, running in the background and storage, applied as you change them
Account and team actions moved into the avatar menu, with Keyboard Shortcuts and About Matras in the main menu
No desktop notification while the window is in use, only the sound; notifications are withdrawn once the channel is read and show text without Markdown
Errors are explained in words, and a failed start with nothing saved offers to retry
Deleting a scheduled message can be undone
The window fits screens down to 360×294

description.p: Android messages scroll on drag, open threads on tap and expose text selection and actions on long press.
